instruction.text: Match the suffixes to their meanings

atoms.sound: the suffix, full, means full of

instruction.text: Choose the right adjectives to complete the sentences.

atoms.a: I have to be very careful around the house at the moment because my dad is doing some D-I-Y.
atoms.b: I have to be very ((++careful careless)) around the house at the moment because my dad is doing some DIY.

atoms.a: Yes, you need to stay away from the powerful tools.
atoms.b: Yes, you need to stay away from the ((++powerful powerless)) tools.

atoms.a: It doesn’t help that my dad is completely thoughtless! He’s always leaving nails lying around.
atoms.b: It doesn’t help that my dad is completely ((thoughtful ++thoughtless))! He’s always leaving nails lying around.

atoms.a: Ouch! That could be pretty painful.
atoms.b: Ouch! That could be pretty ((++painful painless)).

atoms.a: Also, he’s useless at D-I-Y. All he’s done so far is put up a wonky shelf.
atoms.b: Also, he’s ((useful ++useless)) at DIY. All he’s done so far is put up a wonky shelf.

atoms.a: Oh yeah, I saw that! At least it’s colourful.
atoms.b: Oh yeah, I saw that! At least it’s ((++colourful colourless)).

atoms.a: I know! He’s completely fearless when it comes to being bold.
atoms.b: I know! He’s completely ((fearful ++fearless)) when it comes to being bold.

atoms.a: Well, I’m hopeful that it will all look good in the end.
atoms.b: Well, I’m ((++hopeful hopeless)) that it will all look good in the end.
